_comment: Single source for response headers. Rendered into the nginx config (security-headers.conf, embed-headers.conf) and, in Phase 9, the failover Worker so mirror responses match the origin. HSTS is set at the Cloudflare edge. `embeds` is the separate header set for /embeds/*.html: author-supplied HTML with inline script, isolated by CSP `sandbox` (no site origin), `connect-src 'none'` and no remote resources.
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com https://challenges.cloudflare.com; connect-src 'self' https://cloudflareinsights.com; img-src 'self' https://media.smkabir.com data:; frame-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'

embeds.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; sandbox allow-scripts; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'
